strongest_angle: Waymo LLC recalled 4,488 vehicles equipped with 5th and 6th generation automated driving systems following 11 incidents of robotaxis entering closed freeway lanes since October 1, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Waymo LLC announced a voluntary recall covering 4,488 vehicles equipped with 5th and 6th generation automated driving systems.
Since October 1, 2026, Waymo robotaxis recorded 11 incidents of entering closed freeway lanes, with three occurring on November 9.
California's DMV issued a statewide ban on driverless freeway operations after the automated-driving system repeatedly failed to recognize closed freeway lanes across 11 incidents.
